results.detail: Tests show case generation is deterministic (same spec gives identical cases), positive prompts match and negative prompts do not for a well-described fixture skill, a deliberately vague description produces failing trigger cases and an improvement proposal naming them, the JSON report and Markdown summary are written under .factory/, the baseline runner is invoked only with an explicit --runner flag and an executable found on PATH (exercised through a fake runner, never the real claude or codex), and without a runner the report says skipped: no runner while the command still exits 0
